text: Program Description 1.Program Brief Introduction Editor Note: Students will gain strong abilities in the areas of engineering application and technological innovation. Students on this program will learn fundamental theories of mechanical design, micro-electronic technology, fluid transmission and control technology, computer technology, and information processing technology etc. The program aims to cultivate qualified personnel who have a solid foundation in math and mechanics, and interdisciplinary knowledge of mechatronics, electronics, control and computer technology etc. 2. Teaching Objective Editor Note: This program aims to foster high-level technical professionals with strong ability to solve problems. This program mainly focus on fundamental theory of mechanical design, Microelectronics technology, fluid drive and control technology, the basic knowledge of computer technology and information processing technology. This program cultivates specialists who are proficient in the knowledge of mechanical and electrical hydraulic control, and have fundamental knowledge in the field of major program and professional knowledge of related field. The graduation students would be high-level technical professionals with scientific thinking manner and creative thoughts. 3. Why choose to study this program? Editor Note: Students will be trained to be practical technicians to adapt to the fiercely competitive world. This major is designed to cultivate international practical technical personnel with: Basic principles and knowledge about modern mechanical & electronic technology; Practical skills needed in mechanical designing & mechanical manufacturing; Operating of digital control processing. 4. Main Courses Editor Note: Students will have 8 main courses to study this program. Engineering Mechanics Mechanical Design Mechanical Manufacturing Electrical and Electronic Technology Mechanical Engineering Materials Fundamentals of Manufacturing Technology Digital Control Technology CAD/CAM Technology You can download the newest curriculum here >> 5. Internship and Career Development Editor Note: Graduates generally work as product or management service provider. Graduates are prepared for employment in: Product design, product manufacturing, digital control programming and equipment maintenance in related enterprises. Business management and technology management etc. 6. Further Study Editor Note: After the undergraduate study, students take an advantage to pursue a master degree in various fields. Graduates could apply for a master degree in the leading technological areas such as mechanical and electronic engineering, mechanical design and theory, vehicle engineering, material processing and control engineering, machine design, manufacturing and automation, etc. One third of the undergraduates can be admitted to master degree programs, since those who have excellent performance during undergraduate study can be excused from examination and directly go on postgraduate study. 7. School Introduction Editor Note: One of the best engineering university in China. Shandong University of Science and Technolog y (SDUST), a key university of Shandong Province with distinct features, founded in 1951, is a multi-disciplinary university, offering comprehensive education in engineering, sciences, management, humanities, law, economics and education while giving prominence to engineering and the integration of science and engineering. Learn More >> 8. College of International Exchange Editor Note: The College is able to offer the best education in cutting-edge disciplines to international students around the world. The College of International Exchange at Shandong University of Science and Technology (SDUST), established in 2007, is an administrative institution for the education of international students, and promotion of the Chinese language and international cooperative education programs, etc. The College attaches great importance to the quality of teaching, and has conducted an all-round innovation in its teaching philosophy, its program delivery model and its management strategies. Ever since its establishment, the number of international students has been on a rapid increase. The College organizes a variety of campus activities for international students each year, including a New Year's party, Graduation Party, Chinese Language Proficiency Competition, Photography Contest, and sports, etc. 9.
